title: Release notes
description: Turn the changes since a tag into user-facing release notes.

nodes.title: Collect changes
nodes.prompt: List the changes merged since {{input:since}} using git log, grouped as features, fixes and internal work. One line each.

nodes.title: Review changes
nodes.question: Write release notes from these changes?

nodes.title: Write notes
nodes.prompt: Write release notes for users from the collected changes. Leave out internal work. Plain language, short bullets.
